dialogs.text: (A chest that contains some part of the Curatorium of Secrets's finances.)
(I'll come back and check again later...)
(I'll come back and check again later...)
(I'll come back and check again later...)
(I'll come back and check again later...)
(Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> would like to inspect the chest...)
We've been making a decent profit lately. Ashru might be in line for an extra meal.
You open the chest...
(Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> would like to inspect the chest...)
Heh, that's about right. This chest can rest for a while.
(Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> would like to inspect the chest...)
Heh heh... Let's see how much we've made recently.
I remember Boss saying she was going to give me a bonus. How about I help m—
Huh? Where's the money? There's nothing in here but a slip of paper...
"My dear Jahoda, your bonus doesn't come from this box. Be sure to close it properly afterward."
Pfft, Boss is trying to scare me again. Maybe there's a hidden compartment inside here somewhere...
There isn't any hidden compartment in there. Your bonus is right here.
Oh, thanks Boss. I—
Eeek! BOSS!!! I-I-I was just doing a cash count!!!
I will get to work now, right now—
Stop right there.
Yes, Boss!
Lock the box properly.
Yes, Boss!
Now you can go.
Yes, Boss!
(Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> would like to inspect the chest...)
Hmm... I'll take some out to pay the bills.
You open the chest...
(Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> would like to inspect the chest...)
That looks about right. This is all that's left after paying the bills. *sigh* If only we had a few more customers from Liyue...
You open the chest...
(Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> would like to inspect the chest...)
Sheesh... How is it that Boss seems to know everything? When did she even get there...?
(Looks like there's no way to open it...)
(Perhaps this chest can only be opened by the staff at the Curatorium of Secrets...)
